source: PROJECT_PLAN.md §2 (sourced values); everything marked placeholder awaits a datasheet or BOM entry, tracked in issue #6
note: Stand defaults. The single-circuit GN2 stand uses the ox-circuit parts. The full cold-flow stand adds fuel and purge parts: sameAs copies placeholders from a part that is also unselected, and sourced fields are restated on the part they belong to. Values are in the units a datasheet uses; src/data/components.js converts to SI. Every value carries either a source or placeholder:true with the tracking issue. The app labels placeholders on screen.

T.note: test-day ambient; replace from the test log

p0.note: fill pressure; brief §4.2 cites 2000–2400 psi bottles

V.note: bottle isolation to regulator inlet: about 1 m of 1/4-in tube, a physically plausible run, until the as-built volume is known. Chosen for plausibility, never for solver speed (solver.md §2a)

pSet.source: PROJECT_PLAN §2.3 manifold pressure (flowing, at rated flow)

tau.note: first-order poppet lag; see solver.md §5 on its limits

set.note: set Δp; to be fixed with the MEOP decision

tauLift.note: lift response time; sets the fails-open transient peak

sizingMargin.note: C_dA = margin × the build rule's minimum; replaced by the selected relief's rated capacity

V.note: regulator outlet to main valve, as built
main valve to injector, as built

Cd.source: brief V-9 hand check (4 × ⌀1.4 mm GOX at 480 psia, 293 K → 38.8 g/s, PROJECT_PLAN §2.2–2.3); one value for every injector circuit; uncalibrated until Phase 5 step 2/3

tau.note: first-order lag of a small diaphragm transducer; a hardware time, not a solver knob

bits.note: ADC width across the channel's full-scale range

noise.note: 1-sigma of the reading; applied only when a DAQ log is given a noise seed

range.note: bottle transducer full scale; covers a 2000–2400 psi fill with headroom
manifold full scale; covers the 480 psia set point and the 600 psi relief
line full scale, same class as the manifold transducer
chamber full scale; covers the 250 psia design point with margin

bottle-fu.note: no fuel bottle selected; same volume and fill placeholders as the oxidizer bottle

hpline-fu.note: no fuel high-pressure run measured; same tube-volume placeholder as the oxidizer line

manifold-fu.note: no fuel manifold volume measured; same placeholder as the oxidizer manifold

line-fu.note: no fuel run volume measured; same placeholder as the oxidizer line

HV-FU-01.note: no fuel isolation valve selected; same placeholders as HV-OX-01

PCV-FU-01.note: no fuel regulator selected; droop, Cv and lag are the oxidizer placeholders

pSet.source: PROJECT_PLAN §2.3 manifold pressure, both circuits (flowing, at rated flow)

PSV-FU-01.note: no fuel relief selected; set, blowdown, lift time and sizing margin match the oxidizer placeholders (one MEOP covers both manifolds)

SV-FU-01.note: no fuel main valve selected; D-5 open; same placeholders as SV-OX-01

SV-FU-02.note: no fuel manifold vent selected; same placeholders as SV-OX-02

PT-FU-01.note: no fuel bottle transducer selected; same full-scale placeholder as PT-OX-01

PT-FU-02.note: no fuel manifold transducer selected; same full-scale placeholder as PT-OX-02

PT-FU-03.note: no fuel line transducer selected; same full-scale placeholder as PT-OX-03

bottle-n2.note: no purge bottle selected; same volume and fill placeholders as the oxidizer bottle

hpline-n2.note: no purge high-pressure run measured; same tube-volume placeholder as the oxidizer line

manifold-n2.note: no purge manifold volume measured; same placeholder as the oxidizer manifold

line-n2.note: no purge run volume measured; same placeholder as the oxidizer line

HV-N2-01.note: no purge isolation valve selected; same placeholders as HV-OX-01

PCV-N2-01.note: no purge regulator selected; droop, Cv and lag are the oxidizer placeholders. The set point below is a stand-in so the circuit can be operated, not a purge specification

pSet.note: stand-in purge set point, not a specification; no regulator selected

mdotRated.note: stand-in rated flow; no purge flow has been specified

PSV-N2-01.note: no purge relief selected; blowdown, lift time and sizing margin match the oxidizer placeholders

set.note: stand-in set Δp above the stand-in purge lockup (set point 100 psia plus 20 psi droop); MEOP not chosen. Not the propellant relief set

SV-N2-01.note: no purge valve selected; D-5 open; same placeholders as SV-OX-01

SV-N2-02.note: no purge manifold vent selected; same placeholders as SV-OX-02

Cv.note: no check valve selected; Cv placeholder in the vent-valve class

crack.note: stand-in cracking Δp; no check valve selected. crack must exceed reseat

reseat.note: stand-in reseat Δp; no check valve selected

PT-N2-01.note: no purge bottle transducer selected; same full-scale placeholder as PT-OX-01

PT-N2-02.note: no purge manifold transducer selected; same full-scale placeholder as PT-OX-02
